breakdown.description: The specified outer-boundary point load is replaced by a distributed end traction
breakdown.reason: The generated specification explicitly repeats the error from the incomplete prompt by replacing the point load with a uniform end traction (T_y = -5000/0.5 N/m) distributed over the right edge. The ground truth requires using a PointSource on the appropriate displacement component to represent the concentrated load, not smearing it over an edge. The agent failed to correct this inconsistency.
